prompt: Lay it out left to right. An arrow labelled "submit" goes from "Order Received" to "Payment Check". Arrows then go from "Payment Check" to each of "Pack Items", "Send Invoice" and "Notify Customer".

    node received: "Order Received"
    node payment: "Payment Check"

Draw a sequence with three parties, in this order: "Browser", "Auth Service" and "User DB". First "Browser" sends "POST /login" to "Auth Service". Then "Auth Service" sends "find user" to "User DB". Then "User DB" replies "user row" to "Auth Service". Then "Auth Service" sends "verify hash" to itself. Then a note over "Auth Service" reads "bcrypt cost 12". Finally "Auth Service" replies "200 OK; token" to "Browser".
reference:
sequence {
    actor browser: "Browser"
    actor auth: "Auth Service"
    actor db: "User DB"
    browser -> auth: "POST /login"
    auth -> db: "find user"
    reply db -> auth: "user row"
    auth -> auth: "verify hash"
    note over auth: "bcrypt cost 12"
    reply auth -> browser: "200 OK; token"
}

prompt: Draw a sequence with two parties, in this order: "Client" and "Server". First "Client" sends "GET /items?page=2" to "Server". Then a note spanning "Client" and "Server" reads "TLS 1.3 session". Then "Server" sends "check cache" to itself. Then "Server" replies "200: [3 items]" to "Client". Finally a note over "Client" reads "render list".
reference:
sequence {
    actor client: "Client"
    actor server: "Server"
    client -> server: "GET /items?page=2"
    note over client, server: "TLS 1.3 session"
    server -> server: "check cache"
    reply server -> client: "200: [3 items]"
    note over client: "render list"
}
